sections.text: Preliminary Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing

items:
Review technical 
 reference material manufactures or manual.

Obtain copy of relay 
 setting from field maintenance file.

Obtain outage for unit 
 protected by this relay

Check that the bus and 
 unit disconnect switches are opened and tagged.

Inspect the secondary 
 circuits of CT, PT miniature circuit breakers.

MCB and all cabling 
 supplying the relay.

Block any disturbance 
 alarms or fault recorders associated with this protection.

Place the two cases 
 one on the top of other (the voltage unit on the top of current unit)

Connect the two units 
 together by the cable connector 7 XV6201 between test plug "X2" in current 
 unit and test plug "X1" in voltage unit.

Connect the power 
 supply cable 7XV6200 (3*380 V) between the plug "X1" in the current unit and 
 the source (careful the positive sequence).

Connect an ammeter 
 with the socket "17 ,18" in current unit and voltmeter with the socket "5,6" 
 in voltage unit.

Test Procedure for transformer Protection Relay RET 
521

items: To inter test mode

Select the (test test mode operation on), then the relay is in test mode 
 and the yellow lamp is flashing .

sections.text:
Block the other function earth fault and restricted 
earth fault which feed from the same current transformer as differential 
protection ,select the (test-test mode-block function E/F is on &RE/F 
is on).

items:
Connect the current leads from (L1&N) on the 
 tester to (L1&N) on the relay.

Increase the current to the relay until the 
 protection function operate ,record this value (pick up value ) and make sure 
 the trip is O.K.

Decrease the current to the relay until the 
 protection function released ,record this value (drop out value )

Repeat the previous steps (1,2&3)for phases L2 & 
 L3 .

Connect the current leads ( L1,L2 , L3 & N ) on 
 the tester to the relay .

inject the three phases current and Increase it 
 until the protection function operate ,record this value (pick up value ) and 
 make sure the trip is O.K.

Connect the timer leads from the tester to free 
 contact on the relay.

Inject current twice the pick up value and 
 determine the operate time.

Close the CBs where the isolators are opened and 
 inject the current to the relay to trip the CBs.
Repeat the previous steps from 1-8 for LV side .

Remove the block function earth fault and 
 restricted earth fault which feed from the same current transformer as 
 differential protection ,select the (test-test mode-block 
 function E/F is off &RE/F is off). Then the relay is ready.

Connect the timer leads from the tester to free 
 contact on the relay.

Inject current twice the pick up value and 
 determine the operate time .

Close the CB's where the isolators is opened and 
 inject the current to the relay to trip the C.Bs.

 fault and diff. prot. which feed from the same current transformer as earth 
 fault protection ,select the (test-test mode-block function RE/F is

Block the other function restricted earth fault 
 and diff. prot. which feed from the same current transformer as over current 
 protection ,select the (test-test mode-block function R E/F is on & 
 diff. is on).

Connect the current leads from (L1, L2, L3, N) on 
 the tester to (L1, L2, L3, N) on the relay.

Select (L1&N) on the tester to inject the current 
 for phase L1, increase the current phase L1 to the relay until the protection 
 function operate ,record this value (pick up value ) and make sure the trip is 
 O.K.

Decrease the current to the relay until the 
 protection function released; record this value (drop out value).

Connect the timer leads from the tester to free 
 contact on the relay.

Inject current twice the pick up value and 
 determine the operate time.

Close the CBs where the isolators is opened and 
 inject the current to the relay to trip the CBs.

Repeat the previous steps (2&3) for phases L2 & 
 L3.

Remove the block function differential protection 
 and restricted earth fault which feed from the same current transformer as 
 over current time protection ,select the (test-test mode-block 
 function Diff. is off &RE/F is off). Then the relay is ready.

Directional 
 over current prot. 66 kv side

Block the differential protection ,select the (test- 
 test mode-block function diff. is on).

Disconnect the m.c.b for PT secondary 
 circuits.

Connect the voltage leads from (L1,L2,L3&N) on 
 the tester to (L1,L2,L3&N) on the relay.

Connect the current leads from (L1&N) on the 
 tester to (L1&N) on the relay.
Inject 3-ph voltages 100 v.
Increase the current to the relay to about 0.5A.
Make the current lag the voltage by 90˚.

Increase the current to the relay until the 
 protection function operate, record this value (pick up value) and make sure 
 the trip is OK.

Decrease the current to the relay until the 
 protection function released, record this value (drop out value).

For p.u. value move the angle until the relay is 
 released and move to back again untie the relay p.u. record this interring 
 value of c/c and move in this direction until the relay is released and move 
 back until the relay is p.u. record this value the other side of c/c .

Repeat the previous steps (3,4,5,6,7&8) for phases 
 L2 & L3 .

Connect the timer leads from the tester to free 
 contact on the relay.

Inject current twice the pick up value and 
 determine the operate time.

Close the CBs where the isolators is opened and 
 inject the current to the relay to trip the CBs.
